claims.text: Overall Green Forest fire in France from 22 Jul 2026 00:00 UTC to 23 Jul 2026 00:00 UTC. Forest fire can have a low humanitarian impact based on the burned area and the affected population and their vulnerability. About 6,769 hectares burned and roughly 2,984 people in the affected area.

GDACS event report (eventid 1029628), re-checked 2 August 2026: window now extends from 22 Jul 2026 00:00 UTC to 01 Aug 2026 00:00 UTC, citing about 47,910 hectares burned and 11,670 people in the fire-affected area — essentially unchanged from 47,913 hectares/11,670 people as of episode 30 (31 July), with the most recent thermal-anomaly detection now 1 August 2026. Alert level remains Red.

description: A fast-moving wildfire broke out in the Gironde department of southwestern France on 22 July 2026 and spread rapidly toward Bordeaux amid extreme heat and strong winds, prompting evacuation orders for suburbs on the city's western edge, including areas near its airport. GDACS escalated its alert from Green to Red as of episode 19 (27 July 2026); as of 1 August 2026 the burned area stood at about 47,910 hectares with roughly 11,670 people in the fire-affected area and the alert remaining Red, with a thermal-anomaly detection recorded that same day, indicating the fire remains active despite reports of evacuees being allowed to return home. Widely reported figures — evacuations variously put at around 110,000 to 320,000+ people, French military mobilisation ordered by President Macron, and activation of the EU Civil Protection Mechanism — have not yet been confirmed by an allowlisted authoritative source.

impact.summary: GDACS's event report (eventid 1029628) keeps this forest fire in France at an Overall Red alert, with the reporting window now extending to 1 August 2026 and about 47,910 hectares burned and 11,670 people in the fire-affected area — essentially unchanged from 47,913 hectares/11,670 people as of episode 30 (31 July). No allowlisted authoritative source has yet published a confirmed death toll or evacuation count for this fire; widely reported figures of 110,000-320,000+ people evacuated, French military mobilisation, and EU Civil Protection Mechanism activation come from non-allowlisted media and have not been independently confirmed here.
